limits: One predeclared matrix on one native aarch64-apple-darwin host; no retries or discarded cells.
Diagnostic bands are finite empirical observations, not confidence intervals or release thresholds.
K1 cannot rescue K10 qualification; the two runs are not pooled.
Physical clock accuracy, thermal state and unrelated host activity were not controlled.
No causal improvement from window length, production speedup or cross-platform runtime claim.
Raw commands, absolute paths and compile-action keys remain private; full private build identity is retained by digest.

protocol.decision_arithmetic: exact checked integer ratios; floating ratios are presentation only
protocol.observer_overlap: Each component is emitted outside its scan timers and the worker immediately continues. Collector parsing, validation and transcript writes may overlap later scans and perturb their elapsed times. K1/K10 differences do not isolate observation length from protocol/observer effects. The protocol is identical for A/B and both runs. No pacing, physical isolation or causal improvement is claimed.
